brand.name: Everstead
brand.voice_and_tone: Plain friendly everyday language like a helpful neighbor. NEVER use em dashes. No hype/filler words (no leverage, revolutionary, seamless, cutting-edge, unlock, empower, harness, supercharge, game-changing, transform, elevate, delve, robust, synergy). Short sentences. Warm, human, grounded in real homes and real energy.

scale.h3: font-heading font-bold text-2xl md:text-3xl tracking-tight leading-snug text-navy-900

components.data_testid_rule: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, links, and cards MUST have a kebab-case 'data-testid' attribute representing their specific action or role (e.g., 'start-assessment-button', 'solar-technology-card').

motion.rule: Keep motion subtle, calm, and grounded. No flashy bounces. Just fade and gentle rise.

Header.layout: Sticky glass header (bg-cream/80 backdrop-blur-xl). Logo on left. Navigation links center. Log in and primary 'Start my assessment' button right.
Header.behavior: Links highlight with a soft underline on hover.

Footer.layout: Deep navy background (#0E2235) with cream text. Huge typography for 'Let's energize your home.' Large CTA section above grid of links.
Footer.components: Logo, tagline, page nav, social placeholders, legal text.

CTA_Band.layout: Bright amber background (#F5A623), large rounded container within main padding. Text: 'Ready to see what your home can do?' + White Pill Button: 'Start my assessment'.

Hero.layout: Split layout. Left: Big heading 'Let's energize your home.', supportive text, Primary button. Right: 3D React Three Fiber scene.
Hero.3d_scene: Realistic stylized house with solar panels, wind turbine, battery, geothermal, trees, fence. Slow auto-rotate. Drag to spin. Floating HTML labels (HTML from @react-three/drei) pointing to parts.
Hero.live_stats: Floating pill chips near the house showing live-looking animated numbers: '+$1,200 yearly savings', '100% clean power', '6 yr payback'.

Features.heading: What Everstead gives you
Features.layout: Grid of 6 cards. Clean white cards on cream bg. Each has an icon (lucide-react, rendered in Sky Blue or Leaf Green) and plain text.

Technologies.heading: Every clean energy option in one place
Technologies.layout: Bento-style grid of technology cards: Solar, Wind, Geothermal, Micro-hydro, Battery. Each card has a subtle illustrative visual or icon and warm description.

Preview.heading: How it works in three steps
Preview.layout: Horizontal row of 3 steps linking to the full 'How It Works' journey.

How_It_Works.mechanics: Sticky left side with plain text explanation. Right side scrolls through interactive visuals.
visuals_per_step: Step 1: Map pin drop on a neighborhood.
Step 2: Animated monthly sunlight bar/area chart (Recharts).
Step 4: Energy production comparison bars vs baseline.
Step 5: Interactive payback line chart with an electricity-price slider, donut chart of pay-vs-rebates.

About.founder_block: Placeholder frame 'Photo coming soon', friendly greeting, mission statement.
About.mission_cards: Row of 3 cards detailing core values (e.g., 'Real homes', 'Plain truth', 'Lasting energy').

Whats_Next.tags: Status tags on cards: Soon (Amber), Planned (Blue), Exploring (Green). Built as small rounded pills.

Retrofit_My_Home.layout: Multi-step wizard centered in screen. Progress bar at top.
steps: Step 1: Property basics (radio buttons/pills for home size, roof type).
Step 2: Energy use (slider for monthly bill).
Step 3: Checking-location loading state (spinner + friendly text).
Results: Ranked technology cards, payback chart (Recharts), 25-year savings chart, available rebates box.
Retrofit_My_Home.results_cards: Highly visual cards showing: Cost, Yearly savings, Payback time, and a 'Plain reason' text block.

Auth.layout: Centered card on cream background. Clean white card, deep shadow.
Auth.elements: Email + password inputs, Google/Apple placeholder buttons, forgot password link.

Dashboard.layout: Logged-in view. Sidebar navigation. Main content area.
Dashboard.saved_homes: Grid of saved home cards. Each card contains: Address, 3D thumbnail image, top recommendation tag, savings amount, 'View my plan' button.
Dashboard.empty_state: Friendly illustration + prompt to 'Start your first assessment'.

images.description: Picturesque brick house surrounded by greenery, sunny day.
Clean modern solar panels on a roof.
Smiling homeowner holding keys, warm and human.

icons.usage: Use rounded, friendly icons. Stroke width 2. Render in accent colors.

anti_patterns_strictly_enforced: NO generic AI template looks (no gradient blobs, no floating isometric geometric shapes).
NO dark mode for this brand. Must remain light, bright, and cream/white.
NO sharp corners on primary interactive elements. Everything must be rounded.
NO 'powered by AI' badges, fake chat bubbles, or robot icons.
